# General AI Agent Platform (Dev’ai Controller)
# Architectural Baseline Specification Version 1.0

> Generalized AI Agent Platform engineered for production execution on Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare Pages, GitHub, and Resend.

## 1. What the Platform Is
Dev’ai Controller is a generalized AI Agent Platform rather than a single chatbot. It combines:
1. Multi-Agent Orchestration (General, Developer, Knowledge, Customer Service, Design, Custom agents).
2. Knowledge Layer with Title IDs, chunking, and semantic vector retrieval (Cloudflare Vectorize + R2).
3. Tool Registry & Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients across GitHub, Figma, Resend, and Cloudflare.
4. Natural-Language Automations Engine with 9 lifecycle states: WORKING, DRAFT, PENDING_APPROVAL, SCHEDULED, ACTIVE, PAUSED, COMPLETED, FAILED, INACTIVE.
5. Deterministic Workflow Engine with consequential action approval gates ([CANCEL] vs [APPROVE]).
6. Embeddable Customer Service Widget (`/widget.js`) with isolated permissions and human escalation.
7. Cloudflare Edge Runtime with native bindings (`AI`, `DB` D1, `STORAGE` R2, `VECTOR_INDEX` Vectorize, `CONFIG_KV`, `AGENT_SESSION` Durable Objects, `WORKFLOWS`/Cron Triggers).
8. Zero-Trust secret isolation (AES-256-GCM authenticated cipher with 96-bit IVs and zero browser exposure).

## 2. Core Architectural Principle
AI plans and interprets.
Knowledge supplies factual context.
Tools perform actions.
Workflow Engine executes deterministic steps.
Permissions control access.
Approval controls consequential actions.
Cloudflare executes production workloads.
GitHub is the authoritative source-of-truth repository.

## 3. Agents Registry
- **General Agent (`agent-general-01`)**: Primary orchestrator formulation execution plans, knowledge retrieval, and tool dispatches.
- **Developer Agent (`agent-developer-01`)**: Codebase specialist integrated with GitHub REST API and Cloudflare Workers for surgical diffs, PR dispatches, and edge deployment automation.
- **Knowledge Agent (`agent-knowledge-01`)**: Document ingestion, chunking, semantic retrieval, and factual truth verification engine.
- **Customer Service Agent (`agent-customer-01`)**: Isolated, zero-privilege embeddable customer representative for public webchats and widget embeds.
- **Design Agent (`agent-design-01`)**: Interface & design system specialist integrated with Figma MCP for token inspections and component specs.
- **Custom Agent (`agent-custom-01`)**: Configurable edge agent tailored for multi-step webhook ingestion and database reconciliations.

## 4. Controlled Tool Registry & MCP Architecture
Tools are dynamically discoverable and permission-enforced:
- `knowledge.search`: Semantic vector search across tenant-authorized documents.
- `knowledge.add`: Ingest, chunk, and index a document with an immutable Title ID.
- `email.send`: Transactional email dispatch via Resend API pipeline (Requires Approval).
- `email.schedule`: Registers a cron schedule in Cloudflare Workflows / Cron Triggers (Requires Approval).
- `github.read`: Inspect directory trees, files, commits, and branches.
- `github.write`: Commit surgical AST patch to designated branch (Requires Approval).
- `github.pull_request`: Create PR with verification checklist and summary (Requires Approval).
- `figma.read`: Read typography, color palettes, and component tokens.
- `figma.create`: Create design component specs.
- `cloudflare.read`: Read active worker versions, environments, and health.
- `cloudflare.deploy`: Deploy edge release to Cloudflare global network (Requires Approval).
- `agent.call`: Invoke sub-agent (e.g., General Agent -> Design Agent -> Result).
- `task.schedule`: Schedule deterministic workflow execution on Cloudflare triggers.
- `workflow.run`: Execute workflow step sequence with audit logging.

## 5. Knowledge Architecture & Title IDs
Knowledge objects are independent from the agent and reusable across workflows.
Each knowledge object has a unique `Title ID`:
- `monthly-client-email-v1` (HTML executive briefing template)
- `company-branding-v2` (JSON brand palette, gradient `#ff6b35` -> `#f38020` -> `#9333ea`, typography)
- `signature-template` (HTML executive email signature)
- `client-recipient-list` (JSON client recipient roster)

## 6. Automations Engine & Validation Contract
Automations formulate from natural language (e.g., "I want to schedule an email on 31").
The AI detects missing parameters and asks clarifying questions:
1. Which month?
2. What time?
3. Who receives it?
4. What is the subject?
5. What content/template should be used?
6. Should it repeat?

Validation checks before approval:
- Required knowledge attached (Title IDs verified)
- Recipient email resolvable
- Schedule unambiguous
- Email tool authorized
- HTML syntax validated without external script tags

## 7. Consequential Action Approval Gate
Actions with external side-effects (sending email, modifying repo, deploying code) require explicit operator review:
- `[ CANCEL ]`: No schedule created, workflow remains in DRAFT/INACTIVE.
- `[ APPROVE ]`: Workflow saved, registered on Cloudflare Cron Triggers, transitioned to SCHEDULED/ACTIVE.

## 8. API Specification (/v1 Namespace)
- `GET /v1/agents`: List authorized agents.
- `GET /v1/agents/:id`: Retrieve agent profile and permissions.
- `GET /v1/tools`: List discoverable tools in the Tool Registry.
- `GET /v1/mcp`: List connected MCP servers.
- `GET /v1/knowledge`: List attached knowledge items with Title IDs.
- `POST /v1/knowledge`: Ingest new document with Title ID.
- `GET /v1/automations`: List automations filtered by status.
- `POST /v1/automations/parse`: Natural-language automation parser.
- `POST /v1/automations/:id/approve`: Approve consequential action.
- `POST /v1/automations/:id/cancel`: Cancel automation proposal.
- `POST /v1/automations/:id/run`: Immediate execution ("Run Now").
- `GET /v1/executions`: Execution audit trail.
- `GET /v1/widget/config`: Embeddable customer widget configuration.
- `POST /v1/widget/chat`: Customer service chat endpoint.
- `GET /widget.js`: Static client widget script.

## 9. Cloudflare Deployment Architecture
- `wrangler.toml`: Complete configuration with bindings:
  - `[ai]`: Cloudflare Workers AI (`@cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct`)
  - `[[d1_databases]]`: SQLite relational data
  - `[[r2_buckets]]`: Documents & assets
  - `[[vectorize]]`: Semantic vectors
  - `[[kv_namespaces]]`: Token cache
  - `[durable_objects]`: Stateful sessions
  - `[triggers]`: Scheduled crons

## 10. Development & Verification Commands
- `npm run build`: Compiles Vite frontend SPA and verifies TypeScript types.
- `npm run lint`: Validates syntax with `tsc --noEmit`.
- `npx wrangler deploy`: Deploys standalone `cloudflare-worker.js` to Cloudflare.
- `npx wrangler dev`: Runs local Cloudflare Worker emulation.
